intro_title: Where free VPNs usually fall short
intro_p1: Free VPNs tend to disappoint in one of two ways. Either they meter you, with a monthly cap and a short list of countries to pick from, or they work fine at home and fail on the network you actually needed them for: the office, the campus, the hotel, the country that filters what leaves it.
intro_p2: VpnHood! CONNECT is free with no cap on traffic and no account to create. Its client and its server are both open source, so how your traffic is handled is a matter of record rather than trust. And where a network blocks VPNs outright, Cloak Mode makes the tunnel look like ordinary web traffic, leaving no familiar signature for deep packet inspection (DPI) to match.

why_title: Why VpnHood! leads the free tier
why_desc: Free tiers usually give something up: a data cap, the useful features held back for paying users, or a codebase nobody outside the company can read. VpnHood! CONNECT does none of that.
why_unlimited_desc: No data caps, no bandwidth throttling and no account sign-up — connect and browse with the full free experience.
why_open_source_desc: Both the client and the server are fully open source, so anyone can audit exactly how your traffic is handled.
why_split_desc: Split traffic by country, by app and by local network — control that rival free tiers simply don't offer.
why_stealth_desc: Turn it on where VPNs are blocked and the tunnel reads as ordinary web traffic, with no signature for deep packet inspection to match.
